meta.paper: Legg, Hallberg & Girton (2006), Comparison of entrainment in overflows simulated by z-coordinate, isopycnal and non-hydrostatic models, Ocean Modelling 11, 69-97, doi:10.1016/j.ocemod.2004.11.006
meta.pdf: Literatura/Legg_2006 - Comparison of Entrainment in Overflows Simulated by z-Coordinate Isopycnal and Non-Hydrostatic Models.pdf
meta.coordinates: x' = x - 1050 km (inlet centre), y' = y - 600 km (slope top) in the DOME benchmark; Legg's x, y
meta.digitization: pages rendered with pdftoppm -r 500 (outside the repo), axes calibrated on the frame and tick labels, curves and markers located by colour; Jackson shear-mixing plan Task 6, 2026-10-30
meta.geometry_note: Legg's non-hydrostatic run: 50-km channel, Orlanski west, no-slip bed; the benchmark keeps MOM6's geometry (class c differences)

corner_E_nonhydro.equation: eq. 14: corner-mean E = (<T_out> - <T_in>)/(<U_rms> <S>) over -50 < x' < 50 km, -50 < y' < 0

transport_nonhydro.source: Legg et al. 2006 Fig. 3a (Ref, thick black time-mean line), journal p. 79 (PDF page 11)
transport_nonhydro.uncertainty: +-0.05e7 m3/s in T (line width ~0.08e7), +-3 km in x
transport_nonhydro.units: m3/s, negative = westward as plotted (pyOCEAN metrics.plume_transport is positive westward)
transport_nonhydro.note: x' from the inlet centre; Legg's inlet is the steep step at -50 < x' < 0. The plotted scale (x 10^7 m3/s, ~22 Sv) is read as printed.

alphaE_nonhydro.source: Legg et al. 2006 Fig. 3b (Ref, blue: from the time-mean transport), journal p. 79 (PDF page 11)
alphaE_nonhydro.uncertainty: +-0.1e-3 in alpha_E (curve noisy at the 10-km sampling: +-1e-3 between samples), +-3 km in x
alphaE_nonhydro.note: sampled every 10 km; finite and positive only for -200 < x' < -50 km (Legg p. 79); the mean of these samples over -180 < x' < -50 km is 1.03e-3 (compare.py truth table, figures scorecard). It is an eq.-12 alpha_E, not Legg's printed 8.6e-4, which is the eq.-14 corner E (corner_E_nonhydro; Legg p. 79: 'of the same order of magnitude as the value just west of the corner'). Checked in the PDF 2026-10-30 (BBL drag-mixing plan, Task 6): labels were correct, only the equation was not stated
alphaE_nonhydro.equation: eq. 12: alpha_E(x) = (dT/dx)/(L U), U = T / integral over A of dy dz (eq. 13), from the time-mean transport

alphaE_fit_nonhydro.source: Legg et al. 2006 Fig. 3b (Ref, red: from a linear fit of the time-mean transport, -180 < x' < -50 km), journal p. 79 (PDF page 11)
alphaE_fit_nonhydro.equation: eq. 12: alpha_E(x) = (dT/dx)/(L U), U = T / integral over A of dy dz (eq. 13), from the time-mean transport
alphaE_fit_nonhydro.note: the red segment of Fig. 3b: eq. 12 with T(x) replaced by a linear fit of the time-mean transport; the caption gives the fit over -180 < x < -50 km but the segment is drawn from about -145 km (samples from -140 km); mean of the samples 1.9e-3

tracer_by_class_nonhydro.source: Legg et al. 2006 Fig. 4 (Ref, latter-half time mean), journal p. 80 (PDF page 12)
tracer_by_class_nonhydro.uncertainty: colour (jet, 0-12.3 scale) +-0.5 x 10^6; class centres read 0.0002 m/s2 lighter than the text's bounds (-0.01 < b < -0.009 for the maximum), snapped to the text; x +-10 km; 4 isolated edge pixels (anti-aliasing next to white) set to null
tracer_by_class_nonhydro.units: x 10^6, interpreted as m2 (integral of s dy dz per x' and class; the plume section ~ 50 km x 300 m = 1.5e7 m2 matches the scale)
tracer_by_class_nonhydro.note: rows = buoyancy classes (b_class_bounds, m s-2), columns = x_km; sampled at the cell centres of a 25-km grid; white = 0 (no tracer)
